## Summary

Describe the change and the user or platform outcome it enables.

## Change type

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — defect correction
- [ ] `db` — schema or migration change
- [ ] `refactor` — behavior-preserving change
- [ ] `chore` — tooling or maintenance

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] D1 migration reviewed for forward and rollback impact

## Multi-tenant safety

Explain how tenant and branch isolation was preserved or verified.

## Deployment notes

List migrations, secrets, bindings, feature flags, or manual steps required.
